scientific_integrity: Analytic enumeration, determinant and Fourier arguments are supplied; exact finite checker is supplementary, not infinite certification. Prior unit-weight wheel correlation and enumeration are credited. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Positive common edge fugacity, wheel graphs and the hub-spoke marginal only.
Local limit fixes the fugacity and finite integer spoke positions.
The finite spoke measure is not asserted to be determinantal or completely negatively associated.
The full text of a highly related 2026 wheel-forest paper was inaccessible; abstract-level comparisons do not resolve every historical-priority question.
title: Wheel arboreal-gas spoke limits are determinantal renewal processes
